blindness_caveat: A general web search for 'Chili's Brinker International mergers acquisitions history' returned Nation's Restaurant News and Hospitality Technology articles alongside several direct 10-Q footnote excerpts pulled from sec.gov by the search index. The events below are dated and scoped from NRN/Hospitality Technology only; no 8-K text was seen. The 10-Q footnote text (Note 2/Note 15 'CHILI'S RESTAURANT ACQUISITIONS') was visible in search snippets before this file was written, which is why blindness is PARTIAL, not full -- consistent with how the Disney and Six Flags gold files handle the same kind of incidental exposure.
note: A structurally different company from everything tested so far: Brinker does small, RECURRING franchisee-restaurant buybacks (asset acquisitions of restaurant units, not whole-company mergers), not headline M&A. Most of these are disclosed only in 10-Q footnotes ('2. CHILI'S RESTAURANT ACQUISITIONS' / '15. FISCAL 2020 CHILI'S RESTAURANT ACQUISITION') with NO standalone 8-K at all (2021-2022's Mid-Atlantic/Great Lakes/Northwest Region acquisitions -- these also never name a counterparty organization, just 'previously franchised restaurants located in [region]', so they aren't included as gold events below even though they're real). Only two of Brinker's real acquisitions named an actual counterparty organization AND got a dedicated 8-K: Pepper Dining Holding Corp. (2015) and the ERJ Dining deal (2019). Scoped to those two only.
